description: This file defines the EvaluationRunTracer class, which extends RunCollectorCallbackHandler to handle evaluation run tracing, token counting, and metrics collection for language model runs within a larger evaluation framework.

classes.name: EvaluationRunTracer
classes.description: A class that extends RunCollectorCallbackHandler to trace evaluation runs, count tokens, extract model info, and report metrics.

methods.name: persistRun
methods.description: Persists a run by calling the superclass method.

methods.name: countPromptTokens
methods.description: Counts the number of prompt tokens in a run using a specified encoding.

methods.name: countCompletionTokens
methods.description: Counts the number of completion tokens in a run using a specified encoding.

methods.name: extractModelName
methods.description: Extracts the model name from a run's serialized or extra metadata.

methods.name: onLLMEnd
methods.description: Handles end-of-run logic for LLM runs, collecting metrics based on token usage and model info.

methods.name: onRunUpdate
methods.description: Updates metrics during a run, including model info and estimated token usage.
